title: health/thousandeyes/YYYY-MM-DDTHH-MM-SSZ.json
description: ThousandEyes lab slip (Kind observation). Written on the first visit, when at least one test row moved materially against the board on health/metadata-thousandeyes.json (state, loss, latency, error rounds, row appeared or vanished), or when coverage is not complete. A quiet visit writes the board only. metrics: one estate row. readings: one row per test + agent that moved, same shape as a board row plus note. Readings carry hops from path-vis-detail (every row on the baseline, degraded rows afterwards, else carried from the board); hops is the edge — there is no relations[] on this stamp. vs_prior.changed: one structured item per reading. Do not store rounds.

headline.description: Which test, which direction, loss / latency / rounds, since when; then how many rows are unchanged and alerts firing.

window.description: The window string passed to the MCP, e.g. 1h.

window_start.description: Oldest round date across the results, when known.

window_end.description: Newest round date across the results, when known.

concerns.description: One test entity-ref per degraded row. Omit others.

metrics.description: One estate row: counts across every test row this visit. Nulls when collection failed.

readings.description: One row per test + agent that moved materially this visit (every row on the first visit). Empty only when coverage is not complete.

unchanged.description: Board rows not replaced by a reading this visit. 0 on the first visit. null when unavailable.

alerts.description: te_list_alerts state=trigger on this window. firing 0 can mean no rule is bound to these tests; it is not proof of health.

prior_watch_id.description: Board last_visit_id at the start of this visit.

delta.description: worse: any row went ok -> degraded, loss rose, or error rounds appeared. better: only rows going degraded -> ok or loss falling. changed: latency moved or a row appeared / vanished with nothing worse. first on the baseline.

field.description: hops: the resolved device sequence (path_devices) differs from the board row; prior/current are the two sequences joined with >.

rows.description: Test + agent rows measured this visit.

reading.description: Board row plus note. Numbers come from the network result rounds in this window; state is the nurse's read of those numbers against the fixed rule in references/thousandeyes.md.

scope.description: test:<testId>/<agentName>. Stable key for the board diff.

server.description: serverIp on the result rows (the far agent's IP on agent-to-agent).

src_device.description: Inventory device whose interface cidr contains the agent's IP (metadata agents[].device). Null when unresolved.

dst_device.description: Inventory device whose interface cidr contains server. Null when unresolved.

keys.description: test:<testId>, device:<src_device>, device:<dst_device>, service:<metadata service> when set, plus device: and interface:<device>/<interface> for each hop path-vis-detail returned that matched a topology cidr.

hops.description: results[0].pathTraces[0].hops[] from path-vis-detail in array order (the API hopNumber is null). Measured on the baseline for every row and on degraded rows afterwards; otherwise carried from the board row. Null only when never measured for this scope.

loss_pct.description: Mean loss over ok rounds, whole number. Null when no ok round.

loss_max_pct.description: Highest loss on any ok round.

latency_ms_avg.description: avgLatency on the newest ok round.

jitter_ms.description: jitter on the newest ok round.

error_type.description: The errorType seen most; null when none.

first_bad_round_at.description: Onset of the current bad stretch: the prior board value when that row was already bad, else the oldest bad round in this window. Null when this window has no bad round.

note.description: The nurse's opinion against the board row: what moved, in which direction, since when, whether the reverse direction agrees, whether latency moved with loss. Not the columns again. No hop list, cause, probe protocol, or cross-test conclusion; no addresses.

n.description: 1-based position in the hops array (hopNumber from the API is null).

device.description: Topology device whose interface cidr contains ip. Null when none.

interface.description: That interface's name. Null when device is null.
